name: session-memory
description: A summary of each Claude Code session, written at every compaction and session end, kept on a git branch that never merges, and handed to the next session.

push.title: Push records to the remote
push.description: Push each record to a memory branch on the repository's remote, so another machine or a cloud session can read it. Off, records stay in this clone, on refs/session-memory/memory. Anyone who can read the remote can read pushed records.

issues.title: File undecided items as GitHub issues
issues.description: File each record's undecided items as issues in the repository, with gh, ten at most per record. Off, they stay bullets in the record.
